en: Black‑and‑white view across a river and meadows toward a historic hilltop complex dominating a small town. The complex combines a massive Gothic cathedral with several high spires and adjoining castle‑like buildings. In the foreground are fields, a low plastered wall with a wooden door, and a few leafless or sparsely leaved trees. The town with traditional European houses lines the riverbank below the fortress. There is no visible printed title or caption on the image.
